items.d: When you're in Aswan you'll have to walk along the Kornish Al Nile (Corniche) at least once. It is a pleasant stroll, made even more pleasant by the fact that you can walk right into the Ferial Gardens at its southern end.
Open-air Cretan folklore museum.

At Minerva Park, at end of Av. Simon Cañas, Guatemala Zona 2. Entrance is Q16. This relief map depicting Guatemala's precipitous topography is so immense you have to view it from an observation tower.

The undersea world of the aquarium has an amazing collection of tropical fish and other vibrant aquatic animals such as turtles and colourful coral. The tiger zoo is home to Bengal tigers and leopards.
Modern science museum with hands-on exhibits and planetarium.
A Svan Tower with a special purpose.
Remains of a 1790 fort built to protect the harbour.
The central square is lined by the cathedral, town hall, shops, cafés and other businesses. It has a fountain in the middle, benches and colorful flowers and trees.
In summer, you can go canoeing in or walking around the lake Delsjön. It can be a good way to experience nature.
A waterfront public space built around former industrial silos, with public art, a playground, basketball facilities and seasonal events.
Little overlook on the Rio Esmeraldas. Not the prettiest spot but it gives one an interesting view of the coastal topography and the city of Esmeraldas.
Remains of a stone fortress, which enclosed a mosque. This is what is left after Sahrawi rebellions against Spanish and French colonial rule.
You can drive 20 (40 minutes) west along the Highlands Highway to Daulo Pass, a section of twisting roads with good views.

If you go to Zurich during summer take your swimwear with you. The clean river at both the public river baths "Oberer Letten" (mainly youngsters) and "Unterer Letten" (also families) is used by the locals to cool down after hot…
This small community nature preserve is a great place to see woolly lemurs, brown lemurs, and the noctural Goodman mouse lemur.

The oldest secular wall paintings known in Vienna, in a 14th-century building. The frescoes were commissioned in 1398 and illustrate scenes from the life and poetry of the Viennese minnesinger Neidhart von Reuental.
Close to the San Felipe fortress is the 150-m high La Popa hill, which offers great views over Cartagena and the harbour area.
Operated by the Mediterranean Institute and curated by Jan Simič, the museum has a collection of 3,000 shells and aquatic creatures on display, including exotic ones.
This alpine meadow is a popular ski destination in the winter and summer activates include hiking, horse riding and bicycling.
DaKeng in BeiTun District has several hiking paths along elevated wooden walkways. Trails are connected and some loop to connect with other trails. In summer, come early to beat the heat.
A huge lantern release (it is often referred to as the 10,000 lantern release, but there are not as many as that) happens near Mae Jo University on the Saturday before Loi Krathong,.
You can see relics related to rice cake.

A five story residential building in the shape of a giant pastel-striped snail, complete with two antennae.
Ruins of the house of Jonas Savimbi, former leader of UNITA during the civil war. Walls are ridden with bullet holes. Next to the house is the provincial UNITA party office.
The city hall, a large modern building but a bit run-down.
An orthodox cathedral built in the 1990s that has 54 icons.

Opened at the end of 2009, the construction of this building led to numerous allegations of corruption. The design is supposed to represent Trinidad's national flower but it has been much criticised as being out of keeping with…
Monument to the leader of the first European expedition to this part of the world, standing in the middle of Plaza de Armas.
This is a common tour stop, often shrugged at by those who go there. However, if you take a tour bus there, to get a laugh you can always tell people that you took the bus to Hell.
A living museum of Belize tropical treasures. Here, they show you how Belizeans use and recycle natural resources in the construction and decoration of the museum.
Watching sunset in the dusk. There is a natural freshwater pond on this beach.

A church with impressive large dome. You need a passport to get in.
Massive artwork made up of a tightly packed cluster of hillside homes painted in bold colors.
Once the main building of the University of Bologna, it houses the Biblioteca comunale dell'Archiginnasio (Archiginnasio Municipal Library).
El Oddi family built their house in 1920-th, which later fell into a state of complete disrepair and has been restored in 2018.
Gadgets, transport and machinery down the ages.
The main fortress of the ancient town of Mtskheta was located at the high point above the river in strategically good position.
